name: rules-rtdb-r5-cascade-root-grant
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r5-cascade-root-grant" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). root .read: true cascades to all descendants and a deeper .write: false cannot revoke an ancestor .write grant — production allows every op; the simulator must model grant-only cascade.
